verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's API docs show that persons (contacts) and organizations (companies) are first-class records it manages itself, with endpoints such as merging persons and adding followers to organizations. Nothing in the evidence shows persons being linked to organizations, or an activity timeline on either record. missing for 10: documented person-to-organization record linking, a per-record activity timeline or history, UI-level contact/company management docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Add a follower to an organization POST /api/v2/organizations/{id}/followers
